subject: Evidence packaging & tenant segregation for access-log handover
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <s.liu@finvero.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: legal@finvero.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: evidence packaging + tenant segregation for access-log handover

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing a regulatory submission in December and need a handover bundle for our tenant's access/audit logs. A few specific asks from our legal/compliance team:

- Clear manifest of files + time ranges (UTC) included in the export
- Tenant segregation proof (how are records scoped to Finvero tenant ids?)
- Whether exported artifacts include K/V cache traces or only API-level audit events
- Hashes and signing for chain-of-custody (preferred SHA256)
- Retention window and deletion certification steps after package delivery

Can you confirm if Redwood can deliver a packaged export (SFTP or signed Drive link) with per-file checksums and a short packaging checklist? Also confirm a target lead time — we aim to request the handover by Nov 20 and need delivery within 7 business days.

Regards,
Sarah Liu
Senior Counsel — Finvero

Attachments: none

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Sarah Liu <s.liu@finvero.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence packaging + tenant segregation for access-log handover

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — we can support that scope. Quick summary of what Redwood can provide out-of-the-box for a tenant export:

- Export contents: compressed archive with per-day audit/access log slices (JSONL), plus an index manifest (CSV) listing filename, UTC start/end, record count, SHA256 checksum.
- Tenant scoping: every audit record includes tenant_id and org_id fields. We include a "tenant-segmentation-map.png" that shows how shards are cut by tenant and region.
- Trace types: exports include API-level audit events and access trails (who called which model/version and tokenized metadata). We do not include raw KV cache contents by default; that is considered ephemeral. If you require KV-level artifacts, that is special-handling and will need SLAs and justification.
- Chain of custody: manifests are accompanied by SHA256 checksums and an optional PGP-signing of the manifest for verification.
- Deletion certification: after delivery we can run a deletion playbook for the exported slices and provide a signed deletion attestation (timestamp, job id, operator).

Delivery modes: SFTP push to a customer-owned endpoint or a time-limited signed Drive bundle (we can also provide an AWS S3 presigned URL if you prefer). Lead time: given Nov 20 request, we can deliver within 5 business days if we have a signed request + authorized contact for key exchange.

I'll loop in Marissa for packaging ops and Rishi for signing/attestation flow.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): access_logs_archive_manifest_v1.csv (template)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Liu <s.liu@finvero.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence packaging + tenant segregation for access-log handover

+Note for ops runbook and timeline.

Naomi / Rishi —

Operational checklist I've validated for this export:

1) Scope confirmation: confirm Finvero tenant_id list (please provide canonical tenant_id or list).
2) Date range: will produce daily JSONL slices for requested UTC window; min slice size is 1 day.
3) Packaging: create tar.gz with checksums.csv (filename,start_utc,end_utc,sha256,count), tenant-segmentation-map.png, and packaging-checklist.pdf.
4) Signing: Rishi will sign checksums.csv with our PGP key; we will also generate an SHA256-of-tar for extra verification.
5) Transfer: prefer SFTP endpoint; fallback to expiring Drive link (14 days).
6) Post-delivery: run deletion job scoped to the exported object ids and produce Deletion Attestation (job id + operator + timestamp).

Estimated time: prep + verification = 3 business days after we receive tenant_id list and request form signed by an authorized Finvero contact. If Finvero requests KV cache artifacts, add 5 business days and escalate for legal review.

Jordan — can you confirm we have no outstanding export quotas on the Finvero tenant that would throttle the job?

-Marissa
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: handback-packaging-checklist.pdf

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Liu <s.liu@finvero.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence packaging + tenant segregation for access-log handover

Thanks — quick notes on signing/attestation and retention: 

- PGP signing: we will sign the manifest (checksums.csv) and output the signature file checksums.csv.sig (ASCII-armored). We can provide the public key fingerprint: SHA256: 3b:7f:...:a2 (full key available on request).
- Hash algorithm: SHA256; we also produce a separate sha256-of-tar.txt in case Finvero wants single-file verification.
- Retention & deletion: by default our platform retains raw audit data for 365 days (configurable by contract). The exported slices are copies placed in an export bucket; once deletion job runs we will remove copies and produce the attestation PDF. Note: deletion of primary/authoritative logs follows legal hold rules — if Finvero issues a legal hold, we will not purge the source until lifted.

Sarah — two action items for your team to unblock delivery:
1) Confirm canonical tenant_id list and preferred transfer method (SFTP host creds or Drive).
2) Provide the signed export request form (we'll share template).

If we get both today, Marissa and I can start prep tomorrow and meet the 5-business-day target.

-rishi
Security Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
